title: Internet Safety, Netiquette and Data Privacy

activities.title: How many red flags can you spot?
activities.intro: Read the sample phishing email below (it is also on the slide). Count the red flags, then answer the questions.

blocks.label: Inbox · sample phishing email
blocks.subject: URGENT!!! Your refund will be CANCELLED
body: You have an unclaimed refund of P8,450.00. Verify your account within 24 hours or it will be forfieted. Enter your GSIS number, email password and the OTP we send.

blocks.prompt: How many red flags did you find?
Type one red flag you are sure about.
The email is from refunds@gsis-gov-ph.help-desk.site. Who really owns that address?
The attachment is called Refund_Form.pdf.exe. What is it really?

activities.title: Quick check: the GSIS caller
activities.intro: One question. Pick the best answer.

blocks.prompt: A caller says: "This is GSIS. Your loan is overdue. Pay ₱5,000 by GCash today to avoid a penalty." Best move?
options: Give your GSIS number so they can check your record
Hang up, verify through official GSIS channels, and report the number
Post the number in the family GC and ask what to do
